objective: Candidate-free source and gfx1201 ISA feasibility audit of the dominant Q6_K N=5 MMVQ path observed in real target-backed Qwen3.6 MTP verification.

scope.workload: Qwen3.6 target-backed MTP verification with logical N=5
allowed: read registered source and Phase 19 evidence

required_analysis.source_isa_map: Map N=5 weight, Q8_1 activation, scale, accumulator, output-column, row and lane ownership to symbol-local gfx1201 ISA.
required_analysis.reuse: Prove which loads are shared or repeated across five columns and identify the actual serial dependency chains.
required_analysis.shape_inventory: Preserve exact Phase 19 operation classes and M/N/K families on both devices.
required_analysis.designs: Model at least two materially different N=5 work organizations with explicit loads, DP4A, reductions, VGPR, SGPR, LDS, wave and tail projections.
required_analysis.marker: Trace the minimum fail-closed MTP verification marker path from scheduler/context through graph/backend to HIP dispatch without implementing it.
required_analysis.negative_history: Do not reframe Phase 11 vector loads, Phase 16 K2, Phase 17 dot8, Phase 18 stacked rescue, or Phase 19 fixed-width WMMA as new opportunities.

go_gates.mechanism: A design must eliminate, share, or overlap a source- and ISA-proven material cost; moving the same work is insufficient.
go_gates.resource_projection: Projected candidate must retain zero spills/private memory and have a bounded VGPR/SGPR/LDS/wave model relative to the registered N=5 symbol.
go_gates.semantics: Q6_K/Q8_1 layouts, per-column output, numerical accumulation order, fusion, graph behavior and tensor ownership must be preservable.
go_gates.selector: A credible explicit MTP verification marker must reach HIP dispatch; an N=5 shape-only selector fails closed.
go_gates.decision: Authorize a separate immutable Phase 20B candidate only if every gate passes; otherwise close complete_no_go with no build or GPU work.
